This paper presents a cross-dialect Bangla NER framework using the publicly available ANCHOLIK-NER dataset, comprising 17,405 annotated sentences and 101,817 tokens across five major Bangla regional dialects. A Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation (LODOCV) strategy is adopted, training models on four dialects and evaluating on the remaining unseen dialect. Eight pretrained transformer-based models, including BanglaBERT, MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, and Multilingual-E5, are evaluated under identical experimental settings. Multilingual-E5 Large achieves the highest F1-score in every fold, peaking at 97.26% on Mymensingh and reaching its lowest, 82.38%, on Chattogram, the most challenging target dialect. To improve interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are applied to word-level predictions, revealing that the model's decisions are driven primarily by the surface form of the target entity word itself rather than by surrounding sentence context. These findings establish a benchmark for cross-dialect Bangla NER and demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based transfer learning for low-resource regional dialects, while highlighting the surface-form dependence of current models as a direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨方言孟加拉语命名实体识别框架，基于ANCHOLIK-NER数据集和留一方言交叉验证策略，评估八种预训练Transformer模型，多语言E5-Large表现最佳（F1峰值97.26%），并通过LIME揭示模型依赖实体表面形式而非上下文。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语方言（Barishal、Chattogram、Sylhet、Noakhali、Mymensingh）在词汇、形态和句法上差异显著，导致基于标准孟加拉语或单一方言训练的NER模型泛化能力受限，跨方言迁移困难，且该方向缺乏系统性基准。
AI.method: 采用公开的ANCHOLIK-NER数据集（17,405句、101,817词，覆盖五种主要方言）；使用留一方言交叉验证（LODOCV），在四种方言上训练、在未见方言上测试；在统一实验设置下评估八种预训练Transformer模型（BanglaBERT、MuRIL、XLM-RoBERTa、Multilingual-E5等）；并应用LIME对词级预测进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: Multilingual-E5 Large在每一折中均取得最高F1，在Mymensingh上达97.26%，在最具挑战性的Chattogram上降至82.38%。LIME分析显示，模型决策主要依赖目标实体词的表面形式，而非周围句子上下文。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了跨方言孟加拉语NER的基准，验证了基于Transformer的迁移学习对低资源区域方言的有效性，同时指出当前模型对表面形式的依赖是未来改进方向。

title: GPEC: Efficient Pre-LLM Gaussian Process Embedding Correction for Cardiac Video Caption Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for video understanding and caption generation, but their performance may decline in specialized medical imaging domains such as echocardiography. This work introduces Gaussian Process Embedding Correction (GPEC), a modular and computationally efficient pre-LLM error-correction method that improves the visual representations used by VideoChat2 for cardiac ultrasound caption generation. GPEC is inserted between the visual projection layer and the language model and learns a residual correction that moves the projected visual representation toward an annotation-guided target. The target is constructed by converting structured video annotations into qualitative attributes, generating a fixed-format reference caption, and mapping it into the language-model embedding space. The correction is modeled using a sparse variational Gaussian Process with inducing points, natural-parameter variational updates, and a block-wise linear kernel, while the original VideoChat2 components remain frozen.The method is evaluated using representation-level, caption-level, content-oriented, and execution-time metrics by comparing the original VideoChat2 with VideoChat2 + GPEC under identical input and reference conditions. Results show improved caption similarity and content alignment after applying the proposed correction. Furthermore, GPEC adds less than 0.05 s of inference-time overhead per video in the evaluated setting. These findings indicate that GPEC can improve caption generation in specialized medical video domains with minimal computational cost, without requiring end-to-end fine-tuning of the pretrained multimodal backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高斯过程嵌入校正（GPEC），在VideoChat2视觉投影层与语言模型之间学习残差修正，以标注引导的目标嵌入提升超声心动图视频描述生成质量，且几乎不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在通用视频理解与描述上表现良好，但在超声心动图等专业医学影像领域性能下降。端到端微调预训练多模态骨干代价高，因此需要一种模块化、计算高效的前置纠错方法来改善视觉表征。
AI.method: GPEC插入于视觉投影层与语言模型之间，学习将投影后的视觉表征推向标注引导的目标。目标构建方式为：将结构化视频标注转为定性属性，生成固定格式参考描述，再映射到语言模型嵌入空间。校正采用带诱导点的稀疏变分高斯过程建模，使用自然参数变分更新与分块线性核，同时冻结原始VideoChat2组件。
AI.result: 在相同输入与参考条件下对比原始VideoChat2与VideoChat2+GPEC，采用表征级、描述级、内容导向与执行时间指标评估。结果显示描述相似度与内容对齐度均有提升，且在所评估设置中每段视频推理时间开销低于0.05秒。
AI.conclusion: GPEC能以极小计算代价提升专业医学视频领域的描述生成质量，无需对预训练多模态骨干进行端到端微调。

title: Video Captioning in Low-Light Conditions through Efficient Uncertainty-Aware Caption Correction
summary: Low-light conditions can significantly degrade the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to accurately describe human actions in videos. In this work, I propose an efficient uncertainty-aware representation correction framework for improving captions generated by VideoChat2 under real-world low-light conditions. Instead of fine-tuning the underlying VLM, the proposed framework introduces a lightweight sparse Gaussian process-based error estimation module between the projection layer and the language model to correct the intermediate representation. The correction module learns to estimate the residual between the original projected representation and a verified target representation, which is then adaptively scaled using a newly formulated uncertainty-aware coefficient and added to the original representation. To further improve residual estimation, I introduce a partitioned combined-kernel design. The correction model is trained separately using only 44 samples from the ARID dataset and requires only a small additional computational overhead during inference. The effectiveness of the proposed correction is evaluated through quantitative residual prediction and qualitative analysis of the generated captions. Although VideoChat2 is used in my experiments, the proposed framework is designed to be applicable to other compatible VLM architectures. \textbf{Code Availability: The implementation accompanying this work is publicly available at}:\href{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}

AI.tldr: 提出一种不确定性感知的表示校正框架，通过在投影层与语言模型之间插入轻量稀疏高斯过程误差估计模块，提升VideoChat2在低光视频中的动作描述能力。
AI.motivation: 低光条件会显著削弱视觉语言模型（VLM）准确描述视频中人物动作的能力；而微调底层VLM代价高，因此需要一种高效、无需微调主干的校正方案。
AI.method: 在投影层与语言模型之间引入轻量稀疏高斯过程（sparse Gaussian process）误差估计模块，学习原始投影表示与验证过的目标表示之间的残差；用新提出的不确定性感知系数对残差自适应缩放后加回原表示；并设计分块组合核（partitioned combined-kernel）提升残差估计。仅用ARID数据集44个样本单独训练校正模型，推理时仅增加少量计算开销。
AI.result: 通过定量残差预测与生成字幕的定性分析评估校正效果；框架虽在VideoChat2上实验，但设计上可推广至其他兼容的VLM架构。
AI.conclusion: 该不确定性感知表示校正框架以极小训练样本和低计算开销有效改善低光视频字幕质量，且具备跨VLM架构的可移植性；代码已公开。

title: Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs
summary: Effective LLM tutoring depends on correctly identifying the specific error in a student's reasoning before generating feedback. We study this problem in propositional-logic proof tutoring, where student actions can be checked against formal inference rules. We introduce a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, we compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier. Each diagnosis is processed by shared rationale and feedback agents, isolating the effect of the initial diagnosis. The zero-shot detector achieves a macro-F1 of 0.191; fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but retains systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally preserve the diagnosis supplied to them, showing that an incorrect diagnosis can be faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Feedback can likewise remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness, and expert ratings largely uneven with the automatic feedback evaluations. These findings show that apparent feedback quality can conceal upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness. Our code is publicly available

AI.tldr: 该研究在命题逻辑证明辅导中提出"验证器锚定"架构，将错误诊断与语言生成解耦，发现反馈质量可能掩盖上游诊断错误，忠实性与正确性需分别评估。
AI.motivation: 有效的LLM辅导依赖在生成反馈前准确定位学生推理中的具体错误。然而现有辅导系统往往直接优化最终反馈的"表面质量"，可能掩盖诊断环节的错误。
AI.method: 提出验证器锚定架构，将诊断与语言生成分离。以600条均衡的学生行为为数据，对比零样本LLM检测器、微调检测器和符号验证器三种诊断方式；每个诊断结果送入共享的推理（rationale）与反馈代理，以隔离初始诊断的影响。
AI.result: 零样本检测器macro-F1仅0.191；微调后升至0.709，但在结构相关类别间仍存在系统性错误。理由通常忠实保留所受的诊断，说明错误诊断会被完整传播；反馈可同时做到忠实于理由、不泄露答案且教学上恰当，却仍在处理错误的对象。验证器锚定的反馈诊断正确率最高，且专家评分与自动反馈评价结果较大程度不一致。
AI.conclusion: 表面上的反馈质量会掩盖上游诊断错误，因此忠实性必须与正确性分开评估。验证器锚定能提升诊断正确性，为辅导系统的评估设计提供新方向。

title: Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor
summary: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对话幽默中语言模型训练的自动化奖励设计，聚焦奖励利用（reward exploits）及其对策。作者测试了两类奖励：基于嵌入的"意外性"奖励与预测观众愉悦的"观众模型"奖励，发现二者均可被捷径利用（词序打乱文本、笑声线索），并尝试用流畅性过滤与跨说话人线索归一化进行修补。经三轮RL训练迭代修订奖励后，综合评分提升0.0903、零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升仍未达预注册目标。
AI.motivation: 对话幽默缺乏可靠的自动化奖励信号。人工标注成本高且难以规模化，因此需要可自动计算的奖励来驱动语言模型的幽默能力训练。然而，任何自动化奖励都可能被策略"钻空子"（reward hacking），即模型学会优化奖励代理指标而非真正目标行为。本文旨在系统性地识别这些可利用捷径，并在不损害目标行为的前提下设计有效对策。
AI.method: 采用两条奖励路径进行受控实验：(1) 基于嵌入的"可理解的意外性"（understandable surprise）奖励，以词序打乱的回复作为对抗样例检验其区分度；随后引入流畅性过滤器作为对策。(2) 基于观众模型预测笑声（predicted audience amusement）的奖励，检验说话人消息中笑声线索的诱导效应；采用跨说话人线索归一化（normalizing cues across speakers）阻断已覆盖攻击。最后进行三轮强化学习训练，逐次迭代修订奖励版本，并依据预注册目标进行评估。
AI.result: 受控测试显示：基于嵌入的意外性奖励对词序打乱的回复与真正的机智回复给予相近分数；流畅性过滤器能检测出打乱样本，但组合奖励同时误拒部分机智回复，且未能通过后续验证。观众模型奖励易受任一方说话人消息中的笑声线索操纵；跨说话人归一化可阻断已覆盖攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可被利用。三轮RL中最终一轮将综合评估分数提升0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升低于预注册目标。
AI.conclusion: 自动化奖励设计面临一个普遍性挑战：对策必须在阻断可利用捷径的同时保留奖励本意鼓励的目标行为，而二者常存在此消彼长的权衡。单一奖励指标及其修补方案往往难以兼顾鲁棒性与有效性，提示未来的幽默（及更广泛的行为）奖励设计需同时关注捷径阻断与目标行为保真度，并借助多轮迭代与预注册评估进行验证。

title: AdaMerge: Tuning-Free Patch Compression for Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a short paper at ACM CIKM 2026
summary: Multi-vector visual document retrieval (VDR) models such as ColPali and ColNomic achieve strong accuracy by representing each document with hundreds to thousands of patch-level embeddings, at substantial storage and latency cost. Existing compression methods either prune unimportant patches or merge similar ones into clusters; the recent state-of-the-art merging method Prune-then-Merge (PtM) consistently outperforms pruning-only baselines at high compression, but requires a per-dataset cluster budget m to be tuned by grid search. We observe that the merge-cosine sequence produced by hierarchical clustering exhibits a sharp cliff separating mergeable redundancy from salient signal, and that the location of this cliff is concentrated in a narrow band across more than 11,000 documents from 14 datasets. This suggests the merge boundary can be detected per document rather than tuned per dataset. Building on this observation, we propose AdaMerge, a plug-and-play compression method that (i) detects each document's own cliff via gap analysis on the merge-cosine trajectory, and (ii) builds attention-weighted cluster centroids to preserve salient signal. On the long-document benchmark ViDoRe-V2 (4 datasets, two backbones), AdaMerge significantly outperforms tuned PtM across the operating range (p < 10^-4); on the short-document benchmark ViDoRe-V1 (10 datasets, two backbones), where all merging methods are already near-lossless, AdaMerge matches tuned PtM without any per-dataset tuning. AdaMerge adds only about 10 ms per document and exposes a single global hyperparameter shared across all datasets and backbones.

AI.tldr: AdaMerge：一种即插即用的多向量文档检索压缩方法，通过逐文档检测合并余弦轨迹中的"悬崖"来自动确定聚类边界，无需逐数据集调参，在长文档基准上显著优于需网格搜索调参的PtM，且仅增加约10ms/文档开销。
AI.motivation: 多向量视觉文档检索模型（如ColPali、ColNomic）以数百至数千个patch级嵌入表示文档，精度高但存储和延迟代价大。现有压缩方法（剪枝或合并）中，最新SOTA的Prune-then-Merge（PtM）在高压缩率下优于纯剪枝，但需要针对每个数据集用网格搜索调优聚类预算m，缺乏通用性。作者观察到分层聚类产生的合并余弦序列存在陡峭"悬崖"，能区分可合并冗余与显著信号，且该悬崖位置在14个数据集、11000+文档中集中在窄带内，暗示合并边界可逐文档检测而非逐数据集调参。
AI.method: 提出AdaMerge，含两个核心步骤：(i) 通过对合并余弦轨迹做gap分析，检测每个文档自身的"悬崖"位置以确定合并边界；(ii) 构建注意力加权的聚类质心以保留显著信号。方法是即插即用的，仅暴露一个跨所有数据集和骨干网络共享的全局超参数。
AI.result: 在长文档基准ViDoRe-V2（4个数据集、2个骨干）上，AdaMerge在整个操作区间显著优于调优后的PtM（p < 10^-4）；在短文档基准ViDoRe-V1（10个数据集、2个骨干）上，各合并方法已接近无损，AdaMerge无需任何逐数据集调优即可匹配调优后的PtM。每文档仅增加约10ms开销。
AI.conclusion: 合并边界可由逐文档的悬崖检测自动确定，从而摆脱逐数据集调参的负担；AdaMerge以极小的计算开销实现跨数据集、跨骨干的通用压缩，在长文档场景显著提升，在短文档场景无损匹配SOTA。

title: ufakzeka-1: Building and Evaluating a 151M-Parameter Turkish Language Model from Scratch
comment: 8 pages. Model, code, evaluation results and demo: https://ufakzeka.com, https://huggingface.co/ufakai, https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka
summary: We describe ufakzeka-1, a 151M-parameter (182M with embeddings) decoder-only Turkish language model pretrained from scratch on 13.5B tokens of openly licensed text and instruction-tuned for chat, at a total cost of about \$286 in cloud GPU, API and notebook time. The contribution is not the model's capability, which is what a model this size can be expected to have, but the record of building and measuring it: a Turkish byte-level tokenizer at 1.77 tokens per word, a three-stage pretraining schedule, a post-training mixture of openly licensed and generated data, and an evaluation battery of release gates, a rule-checked sweep of 5,508 conversations, judged conversations and hand tests, all with prompts held out from the training data, enforced by decontamination inside the data build and by a checked-in invariant script we run before each build. We report three findings that we believe transfer to other small-model efforts: a safety gate that had been "fixed" with training data written from its own questions read 64/64 while the honest figure was 34/64; training-seed variance was as large as the spread across every recipe we tried, so single-seed comparisons at this scale are uninformative; and data rounds repaired only what was absent from the data, while identity tracking over long context and multi-turn arithmetic did not move across any data change we tried, which we read as limits of the model size rather than gaps in the data, a reading the next, larger model will test. Weights, the data recipe, the evaluation code and the spend ledger are released under Apache-2.0.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 ufakzeka-1：一个从零预训练、含 151M 参数（含嵌入 182M）的土耳其语 decoder-only 语言模型，使用 13.5B 开放许可 token，并进行了指令微调，总成本约 286 美元。其核心贡献不是模型能力，而是完整的构建与测量记录，包括 Turkish 字节级分词器、三阶段预训练、后训练数据混合与评估套件，并总结了三条可迁移发现。
AI.motivation: 论文的动机不是追求该规模模型的性能突破，而是记录一个小模型从构建、训练到评估、审计的透明过程，尤其是低成本、开放许可条件下的可复现实践，并为其他小模型研究提供可迁移的经验教训。
AI.method: 方法包括：从头预训练一个 151M 参数（含嵌入 182M）的土耳其语 decoder-only 模型，使用 13.5B 开放许可文本；采用土耳其语字节级分词器，平均 1.77 tokens/word；三阶段预训练计划；后训练使用开放许可数据与生成数据混合进行指令微调；评估采用发布门槛、5,508 轮对话规则检查扫描、判定对话与人工测试，并通过数据构建中的去污染和构建前运行的不变量脚本保证提示词不泄露。
AI.result: 报告三项发现：1）一个用自身问题生成训练数据来“修复”的安全门槛在测试中达到 64/64，但真实指标仅为 34/64；2）训练随机种子带来的方差与不同配方之间的差异相当，因此该规模下的单种子比较不具备信息量；3）数据轮次只能修复数据中缺失的能力，而长上下文身份追踪和多轮算术在所有数据变化下均未改善，作者将其解读为模型规模限制而非数据缺口。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为这些经验可能迁移到其他小模型工作：需警惕评估数据泄漏，单种子比较不可靠，部分能力瓶颈可能来自模型规模而非数据。模型权重、数据配方、评估代码和支出账本均以 Apache-2.0 许可发布，后续更大模型将检验“规模限制”这一解读。

title: Do Student LLMs Inherit OOD Robustness? Invariance-Weighted Distillation for Reliable Knowledge Transfer
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to compress high-performance teacher LLMs into lightweight students. However, distilled students often exhibit substantial performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, a critical gap that remains underexplored. We identify two compounding mechanisms causing OOD performance degradation: (1) data spuriousness: students can learn spurious correlations in the distillation dataset over genuine causal relationships; and (2) teacher capability: standard KD treats all samples uniformly, ignoring whether the teacher is guided by causal features or misled by spurious shortcuts on a given sample. To address these challenges, we propose Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically reweights training samples using an estimate of the teacher's causal reliance derived from prediction invariance across multiple synthetic environments. IWD perturbs spurious cues while preserving core semantics, assigning higher distillation weights to samples whose teacher predictions remain invariant, indicating greater reliance on causal rather than spurious features. We theoretically show that IWD reduces the student's Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) gradient ratio compared to standard uniformly weighted KD, driving the student toward more invariant representations. Experiments on four NLP benchmarks (MNLI, SQuAD-v2, CoNLL-2003 NER, and SST-2) across two model families (DeBERTa-v3 and Qwen-2.5) demonstrate that IWD consistently outperforms strong KD baselines on OOD evaluations while maintaining competitive in-distribution (ID) performance. Specifically, IWD achieves the highest accuracy in 15 out of 16 OOD benchmarks and improves average OOD performance over standard KD by 4.34 percentage points on NLI and 14.94 percentage points on QA.

AI.tldr: 提出Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD)框架，通过在多合成环境下评估教师预测不变性来动态重加权蒸馏样本，缓解学生模型在OOD场景下的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏在高性能教师LLM压缩为轻量学生时，学生模型在分布外(OOD)场景常出现显著性能下降，且该问题研究不足。作者识别出两个叠加机制：(1)数据虚假性——学生会学到蒸馏数据中的虚假相关而非真实因果关系；(2)教师能力——标准KD对所有样本统一处理，忽视教师在具体样本上是依赖因果特征还是被虚假捷径误导。
AI.method: 提出IWD(Invariance-Weighted Distillation)，一个有理论基础的框架：基于多合成环境下教师预测的不变性估计教师的因果依赖程度，动态重加权训练样本；通过扰动虚假线索、保留核心语义，对教师预测保持不变的样本(表明更依赖因果特征)赋予更高蒸馏权重。理论上证明IWD相比标准均匀加权KD能降低学生的虚假-因果(S2C)梯度比，推动学生学习更不变的表征。
AI.result: 在四个NLP基准(MNLI、SQuAD-v2、CoNLL-2003 NER、SST-2)和两个模型家族(DeBERTa-v3、Qwen-2.5)上实验：IWD在OOD评估中持续优于强KD基线，同时保持有竞争力的ID性能。具体地，IWD在16个OOD基准中的15个取得最高准确率，平均OOD性能相比标准KD在NLI上提升4.34个百分点、在QA上提升14.94个百分点。
AI.conclusion: IWD通过基于教师因果依赖估计的样本重加权，有效缓解了KD学生模型的OOD性能退化问题，理论和实验均验证其优越性，为提升蒸馏模型的分布外泛化能力提供了有效方案。

title: Beyond the Leaderboard: Counterfactual Diagnosis of End-to-End and VLA Driving Policies Under Domain Shift
summary: End-to-end and vision-language-action (VLA) driving policies are compared by leaderboard rank, but a rank reports an outcome, not the behaviour behind it, so it predicts poorly how a policy will behave at a new site. On six released policies, rank on nuScenes open-loop error or on NAVSIM's leaderboard does not carry over to scenes with a pedestrian near the ego corridor at a new site. We propose a counterfactual check-up: a few hundred real frames, each edited two ways (pedestrian removed, or re-lit by a night-style perturbation), every edit verified by an independent detector, and the change in the planned trajectory read as a diagnosis rather than a score. From these edits two causal axes are read, and five exams built on them separate what a score merges: how far the policy plans to drive, whether seeing the pedestrian buys safety, whether that response scales with danger, whether the plan moves when nothing requires it, and how much an irrelevant lighting change moves it. On 246 NAVSIM near-pedestrian scenes, in the cells where the pedestrian lies on the planned path only 1.9% of responses are genuine avoidance, and under our open-loop protocol the median clearance change is at most 0.03 m and the median change in planned distance at most 0.08 m for every policy. In a pre-registered test from left- to right-hand drive, the exposure and specificity orderings, the lighting verdict and the collision outcome transfer, while point values and the hazard-sensitivity verdict do not. Read as a selection report, the profiles say which policy is safe because it plans short, which covers a human-like distance without yielding, and which is unsteady under a change that requires no reaction, and they price each verdict: most settle within a few dozen frames, hazard sensitivity needs hundreds. Code and edited frames will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"反事实体检"方法，用数百帧真实驾驶画面各做两种编辑（移除行人、夜间化扰动），通过独立检测器验证编辑后读取规划轨迹变化，构建两条因果轴与五项考试，以诊断而非打分的方式刻画端到端/VLA驾驶策略在新场地的真实行为差异。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端与VLA驾驶策略以排行榜名次（如nuScenes开环误差、NAVSIM榜单）进行比较，但名次只反映结果而非行为机理，对新场地行为预测能力差。作者观察到在六个已发布策略上，这些名次无法迁移到"新场地中自车走廊附近有行人"的场景，因此需要一种能揭示行为本质的诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出反事实体检（counterfactual check-up）：取数百帧真实画面，每帧做两种编辑——移除行人、夜间风格重打光——每个编辑由独立检测器验证，将规划轨迹变化作为诊断而非分数。由此读取两条因果轴，并基于它们设计五项考试：规划行驶距离、见行人是否带来安全性、响应急剧程度是否随危险度缩放、无必要时的计划漂移、以及无关光照变化引发的漂移。
AI.result: 在246个NAVSIM近行人场景中，当行人位于规划路径上时仅1.9%的响应为真正避让；在开环协议下，各策略的清晰度变化中位数至多0.03 m，规划距离变化中位数至多0.08 m。在从左侧到右侧驾驶的预注册测试中，暴露度与特异性排序、光照判定和碰撞结果可迁移，而具体点值与危险敏感性判定不可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 作为选择报告，这些行为画像可指明哪个策略因规划短而安全、哪个覆盖类人距离但不让行、哪个在无需反应的变化下不稳定，并给出每个判定的代价：多数在几十帧内收敛，危险敏感性需数百帧。代码与编辑后帧将公开。

title: Seeing is not Enough: Vision-Language Models Perceive Evidence but Fail to Act
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) perform strongly on visual question answering benchmarks, yet often make decisions that contradict visual evidence they have already identified correctly. We distinguish perceptual failure, where relevant evidence is not recognized, from process failure, where recognized evidence fails to constrain the final decision. We introduce VPAC-Bench, a benchmark spanning nine real-image process families, with each image annotated by its current activity stage and nearby stage transition. We also propose State-Relevance-Target (SRT), a family of structured process-prior interventions that requires models to connect visible evidence to the relevant process state before answering. Across multiple VLMs, process failure is widespread: models that correctly enumerate visual candidates still over-commit to a single answer in more than 95% of ambiguous cases. An explicit process-structured intervention reduces this rate to below 13% without degrading performance on unambiguous cases. However, the transfer of process priors is model-dependent, and generic SRT does not consistently outperform strong chain-of-thought baselines. When the relevant stage transition is known, boundary-aligned SRT substantially outperforms generic process prompting and all tested chain-of-thought baselines across assembly, physical state transition, navigation and traffic, and object-use affordance tasks. These results show that process priors are most useful when aligned with the scene's specific decision boundary, motivating boundary-aware prior selection for process-grounded visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VPAC-Bench基准与SRT干预方法，区分视觉语言模型中的感知失败与过程失败，发现过程失败普遍存在，边界对齐的过程先验能显著提升过程性视觉推理表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在视觉问答基准上表现优异，却常做出与已正确识别的视觉证据相矛盾的决策。作者希望区分两类失败：感知失败（未识别相关证据）与过程失败（已识别证据却未能约束最终决策），并探究过程性先验在视觉推理中的作用。
AI.method: 提出VPAC-Bench基准，涵盖九个真实图像过程族，每张图像标注当前活动阶段及邻近阶段转换；并提出State-Relevance-Target（SRT）结构化过程先验干预族，要求模型在作答前将可见证据与相关过程状态相连接。
AI.result: 多个VLM中过程失败普遍存在：即便能正确枚举视觉候选，模型在超过95%的歧义案例中仍过度锁定单一答案；显式过程结构化干预将该比例降至13%以下且不损害无歧义案例表现。过程先验的迁移依赖模型，通用SRT未稳定优于强链式思维基线；但当相关阶段转换已知时，边界对齐SRT在装配、物理状态转换、导航与交通、物体使用可供性任务上显著优于通用过程提示与所有测试的链式思维基线。
AI.conclusion: 过程先验在与场景特定决策边界对齐时最为有用，这为过程接地的视觉推理指明了方向：应采用边界感知的先验选择策略。

title: Preserving What Matters: Semantic Scaffolds Beyond Saturation in Summarization Evaluation
comment: Accepted at the AIMS Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Summarization ships in countless production systems, making model selection a routine decision that depends on measuring summary quality. Existing metrics struggle to support this: ROUGE captures only surface overlap, while LLM-as-judge scores saturate to near-identical values that fail to rank models effectively. We observe this saturation across three public datasets, two proprietary datasets, and multilingual settings. Motivated by this, we introduce Semantic Scaffold, an evaluation framework that extracts a hierarchical representation of facts, questions, and entity attributes from a source text, labeling each as a main point or supporting detail, and reusing this structure as a fixed reference for scoring summaries. From this representation, we derive three diagnostic metrics: Fact Preservation Score (FPS), Question Preservation Score (QPS), and Entity Preservation Score (EPS), designed to reward the preservation of essential information while penalizing detail overload, and position them as interpretable diagnostics that remain informative where holistic axes collapse. Finally, we analyze four recurring failure modes of ROUGE and LLM-as-judge scores, demonstrating that scaffold-based evaluation remains informative where conventional metrics collapse.

AI.tldr: 针对摘要生成中ROUGE仅测表面重叠、LLM-as-judge评分饱和失效的问题，本文提出Semantic Scaffold评估框架，从源文本抽取事实、问题与实体属性的分层结构并标注主次，作为固定参考，据此定义FPS、QPS、EPS三个诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 摘要在生产系统中广泛部署，模型选择依赖摘要质量度量。但现有指标难堪此任：ROUGE只反映表面重叠，LLM-as-judge分数趋于饱和、数值近乎相同，无法有效排序模型。作者在三个公开数据集、两个私有数据集及多语言场景中都观察到这种饱和现象。
AI.method: 提出Semantic Scaffold评估框架：从源文本中抽取由事实、问题、实体属性构成的分层表示，并将每项标注为主要观点或支撑细节，随后将该结构复用为评分摘要的固定参考。基于该表示导出三个诊断指标——Fact Preservation Score（FPS）、Question Preservation Score（QPS）与Entity Preservation Score（EPS），设计上奖励关键信息保留、惩罚细节过载。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集、两个私有数据集及多语言设置中确认了LLM-as-judge评分的饱和现象；通过scaffold表示导出的FPS、QPS、EPS可作为可解释诊断，在整体性维度失效处仍保持信息量。同时归纳并分析了ROUGE与LLM-as-judge评分的四种反复出现的失效模式，证明基于scaffold的评估在传统指标崩塌处依然有效。
AI.conclusion: ROUGE与LLM-as-judge在摘要评估中存在系统性缺陷（表面重叠、评分饱和），而Semantic Scaffold以分层结构化参考结合FPS、QPS、EPS三项诊断指标，能提供更可解释、更具区分度的评估，在传统指标失效处仍保持信息量，为摘要模型选择提供更可靠依据。

title: Pretrained Persona Mixture Models and Tandem Models for Human Simulation
comment: 11 pages in body, 36 with appendices. 7 figures. 8 tables
summary: We argue here that the current dominant practice in LLM human simulation: prompting instruction-tuned assistant language models to role-play personas, is inaccurate and produces stereotyped predictions (lacking natural diversity). It has previously been shown that LLMs can be bound to personas using naturalistic, freetext dialog avoiding stereotyping. Here we show that binding can also be achieved using short, individual samples of dialog from specific people. Demographics can be added later without negative effects by simply querying the model. We use the term Persona Mixture Models (PMMs) for well-calibrated human models, currently realized as pretrained base models. We show that PMMs produce more accurate predictions than instruction-tuned models and retain more of the lexical, semantic, and pragmatic diversity found in human dialog. We measure realism and diversity of LLMs simulating human interlocutors across a diverse set of corpora spanning open-domain text, human-AI chat, and task-oriented dialogue between human speakers. However, base pretrained models can produce out-of-domain dialog and may lose some of the human's internal state over long contexts. We propose and explore tandem models which combine a pre-trained model with an instruction-tuned supervisor. Tandem models achieve the best overall accuracy and diversity in our experiments.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出通过指令微调模型角色扮演来模拟人类的主流做法不准确且产生刻板预测，提出用短对话样本绑定人格的Persona Mixture Models（PMM），并进一步提出预训练模型+指令微调监督器的串联模型，在准确性与多样性上取得最佳效果。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM人类模拟的主流实践是提示指令微调的助手模型去角色扮演特定人格，作者认为这种做法不准确，且会产生刻板化预测，缺乏人类对话中自然存在的多样性。已有研究表明可用自然化自由文本对话将LLM绑定到人格并避免刻板化，本文希望探索更简便、更通用的绑定方式并提升模拟的真实性与多样性。
AI.method: 1）用特定人物的简短个体对话样本实现人格绑定；2）绑定后再通过简单查询模型加入人口统计信息，且不产生负面影响；3）将这类校准良好的人类模型称为Persona Mixture Models（PMM），当前以预训练基础模型实现；4）针对基础预训练模型可能产生域外对话、长上下文中丢失人物内部状态的问题，提出串联模型（tandem models），将预训练模型与指令微调监督器结合；5）在开放域文本、人机聊天、任务导向的人-人对话等多类语料上评估模拟人类对话者的真实性与多样性。
AI.result: PMM比指令微调模型产生更准确的预测，并保留更多人类对话中的词汇、语义和语用多样性。串联模型在实验中取得最佳的整体准确性与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 以短对话样本绑定人格的PMM优于指令微调角色扮演范式，能提升模拟准确性与多样性；串联模型进一步缓解基础预训练模型的域外输出与长上下文状态丢失问题，是综合表现最佳的方案。

title: X-Beat: An Explainable Framework for ECG Image Classification
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Data Quality Aware, High-Performance, and Trustworthy AI Systems for Healthcare at IEEE/ACM CHASE 2026
summary: Accurate automated interpretation of electrocardio- grams (ECGs) is essential for early detection of cardiac condi- tions such as myocardial infarction and rhythm abnormalities. However, many high-performing deep learning models remain difficult to deploy in clinical settings due to limited transparency and lack of reliability validation. In this work, we present X- Beat, an explainable and reliability-aware benchmark framework for ECG image classification designed to support trustworthy AI systems in healthcare. The proposed framework combines transfer learning with post-hoc explainability and systematic reliability evaluation across four cardiac classes: Abnormal Heartbeat, History of Myocardial Infarction, Myocardial In- farction, and Normal Heartbeat. Multiple ImageNet-pretrained CNN backbones, including EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50, DenseNet- 121, and MobileNetV3-Large, are evaluated under a unified training protocol. Beyond standard performance metrics, we incorporate Grad-CAM-based visual explanations together with additional analyses, including explanation stability, regional sen- sitivity, and confidence-based reliability assessment, to examine whether model predictions are supported by clinically meaningful evidence. Experimental results show that ResNet-50 achieves the best performance, reaching 91.94% accuracy and a macro F1- score of 0.9098, with strong class separability (AUC up to 0.995). Explanation analyses indicate that the model primarily focuses on waveform-relevant regions, while reliability evaluation suggests that most incorrect predictions occur with lower confidence. Overall, this work provides a structured and reproducible bench- mark for evaluating both predictive performance and explanation reliability in ECG image classification, contributing toward the development of trustworthy and interpretable AI components for clinical decision support systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 X-Beat：面向心电图图像分类的可解释、可靠性感知基准框架，融合迁移学习、Grad-CAM 后验解释与系统化可靠性评估，在四类心脏状态上统一评测四种 CNN 主干网络。
AI.motivation: 心电图的自动化准确解读对心肌梗死、节律异常等心脏疾病的早期发现至关重要，但许多高性能深度模型因透明度不足、缺乏可靠性验证而难以在临床落地。研究需要同时兼顾预测性能与解释可信度的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 X-Beat 基准框架：采用迁移学习 + 后验可解释性 + 系统化可靠性评估的组合方案，任务覆盖四类（异常心跳、心肌梗死病史、心肌梗死、正常心跳）。在统一训练协议下评测多种 ImageNet 预训练 CNN 主干（EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50、DenseNet-121、MobileNetV3-Large）；在常规性能指标之外，引入 Grad-CAM 可视化解释，并开展解释稳定性、区域敏感性与基于置信度的可靠性分析。
AI.result: ResNet-50 表现最佳，准确率 91.94%，宏 F1 为 0.9098，类别可分性强（AUC 最高 0.995）。解释分析显示模型主要关注与波形相关的区域；可靠性评估表明大多数错误预测伴随较低置信度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为心电图图像分类提供了一个结构化、可复现的基准，可同时评估预测性能与解释可靠性，有助于构建面向临床决策支持的可信、可解释 AI 组件。

title: Beetle: A Bilingual Model Suite for Modelling Second-Language Processing
summary: Bilingual language models (LMs) offer a controlled setting for studying how training conditions shape second-language (L2) behaviour, but prior work typically varies exposure structure, scale, and architecture at once, making it difficult to attribute effects to any single factor. We introduce Beetle, a controlled language model pretraining framework in which tokeniser, target language, training budget, and exposure structure are each independently manipulable, enabling systematic and comparable experimentation of training conditions. Using Beetle, we train and release 285 bilingual and 45 monolingual open-source LMs with rich checkpoints across a range of exposure schedules, data scales and first languages (L1s) to study multilingual pretraining and computational modelling of bilingualism and second language learning. Evaluating models on human bilingual and second language reading-time prediction and grammaticality judgement tasks, we find that staged and temporally structured curricula consistently improve alignment with language learner reading time compared to balanced bilingual training, with the largest gains at smaller data scales and for typologically closer language pairs. The Beetle models are well suited tools to help move computational psycholinguistics beyond its prevailing monolingual, English-centric focus toward models of human bilingual processing, to study cross-lingual learning dynamics, while supporting community-based development of controlled model families.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Beetle 双语语言模型预训练框架，可独立操控分词器、目标语言、训练预算与暴露结构，训练并开放了 285 个双语和 45 个单语模型，用于研究双语与二语学习建模。
AI.motivation: 以往研究双语语言模型时往往同时改变暴露结构、模型规模与架构，导致难以将效应归因于单一因素；同时计算心理语言学长期以单语、英语为中心，缺乏可控的双语加工模型。
AI.method: 构建可控预训练框架 Beetle，使分词器、目标语言、训练预算与暴露结构均可独立操控，并据此训练覆盖不同暴露时间表、数据规模与母语（L1）的多检查点双语（285 个）与单语（45 个）模型。
AI.result: 在人类双语与二语阅读时间预测和语法判断任务上，分阶段、时间结构化的课程相比均衡双语训练能持续提升与学习者阅读时间的对齐度，且在小数据规模和类型学更接近的语言对中增益最大。
AI.conclusion: Beetle 模型可作为推动计算心理语言学从单语、英语中心转向人类双语加工与跨语言学习动态研究的工具，并支持社区开发可控模型族。

title: AWR-Net: Decoupling Anatomy and Appearance for 3D Fetal Brain Ultrasound Synthesis
summary: Three-dimensional fetal brain ultrasound offers non-ionizing, cost-effective imaging with rich spatial information for comprehensive anatomical assessment, yet its development remains limited by scarce data and annotations. In contrast, fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging has advanced further, supported by larger datasets and mature analysis methods. To leverage these resources, anatomical label maps provide a promising modality-invariant bridge for transferring knowledge from fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging to ultrasound. However, generating ultrasound images from label maps remains challenging because anatomy is tightly entangled with ultrasound appearance. To address this challenge, we separate anatomical correspondence learning from ultrasound appearance adaptation at both the data and model levels. Specifically, we propose the anatomy wavelet residual network, a two-stage framework combining wavelet diffusion and residual refinement. The first stage learns to generate volumes from label maps using atlas pairs in the wavelet domain, while the second stage learns bounded residual corrections from real clinical ultrasound in the image domain. This separation enables realistic synthesis with consistent preservation of normal and abnormal anatomy. Experiments on real fetal brain ultrasound show that our method outperforms representative synthesis methods, with normalized cross correlation of 0.518 versus 0.482 and Fréchet Inception Distance of 8.905 versus 13.319 for the strongest baseline. Beyond synthesis quality, volumes generated from fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging label maps also improve downstream segmentation, particularly for severe abnormal cases. Overall, these results highlight the potential of the proposed framework to leverage rich fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging resources for advancing three-dimensional ultrasound analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出Anatomy Wavelet Residual Network两阶段框架，将解剖对应学习与超声外观适配解耦，实现从MRI标签图合成逼真3D胎儿脑超声，并提升下游分割性能。
AI.motivation: 3D胎儿脑超声具有无电离、低成本、空间信息丰富等优势，但受限于数据与标注稀缺；而胎儿脑MRI数据规模大、分析方法成熟。解剖标签图可作为模态无关的桥梁，把MRI知识迁移到超声，但由标签图生成超声图像困难，因为解剖结构与超声外观高度耦合。
AI.method: 在数据层与模型层分离解剖对应学习与超声外观适配。提出Anatomy Wavelet Residual Network，两阶段框架：第一阶段在小波域利用图谱对学习从标签图生成体数据（小波扩散）；第二阶段在图像域从真实临床超声学习有界残差修正（残差精修）。该解耦保证解剖结构（含正常与异常）的一致性保留。
AI.result: 在真实胎儿脑超声上优于代表性合成方法：归一化互相关0.518 vs 最强基线0.482，Fréchet Inception Distance 8.905 vs 13.319。此外，由胎儿脑MRI标签图生成的体数据还能提升下游分割，尤其在严重异常病例上效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有望利用丰富的胎儿脑MRI资源推动3D超声分析发展。

title: ConsistWorld: Evidence Routing for Consistent Multi-Agent World Models
summary: Autoregressive video world models enable temporally coherent generation for a single observer. Extending them to multiple agents requires consistency across independently controlled views and temporal gaps under causal streaming. We present ConsistWorld, a multi-agent world model that generates camera-controlled video streams of a static scene from one shared image. We formulate consistency as routing evidence from committed multi-agent history and concurrently generated peer views to the tokens being generated. Pose Conditioned Memory Retrieval selects relevant historical observations from all agents, recovering evidence beyond the recent context window. Visibility-Gated Peer Sharing regulates current peer information according to estimated historical coverage and current-view overlap. Together, they determine which historical observations enter the context and where concurrent peer information contributes, supporting long-term recall and coordinated exploration. Both mechanisms use camera geometry and maintain a bounded active context for a fixed agent count and retrieval budget. Experiments on evidence sharing cases and video length and agent number generalizations show that ConsistWorld achieves a strong cross-time and cross-agent consistency while preserving competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: ConsistWorld：多智能体世界模型，从单张共享图像生成相机可控的多视角视频流，通过姿态条件记忆检索与可见性门控同伴共享实现跨时间与跨智能体一致性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频世界模型仅支持单个观察者的时序连贯生成；扩展到多智能体时，需在独立控制的视角之间以及因果流式生成下存在时间间隔的情况下保持一致性。
AI.method: 将一致性建模为：从已提交的多智能体历史与并发生成的同伴视角中，向正在生成的token路由证据。包含两个机制：(1) 姿态条件记忆检索（Pose Conditioned Memory Retrieval），从所有智能体的历史观测中选取相关观测，恢复超出近期上下文窗口的证据；(2) 可见性门控同伴共享（Visibility-Gated Peer Sharing），依据估计的历史覆盖度与当前视角重叠度来调控当前同伴信息。二者共同决定哪些历史观测进入上下文、并发同伴信息在何处贡献。两机制均利用相机几何，并在固定智能体数量与检索预算下维持有界活动上下文。
AI.result: 在证据共享案例以及视频长度与智能体数量泛化实验中，ConsistWorld 在保持有竞争力生成质量的同时，实现了较强的跨时间与跨智能体一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何感知的记忆检索与门控同伴共享，可在因果流式条件下将单图世界模型扩展为多智能体一致生成，并具备长度与智能体数量的泛化能力。

title: Math2Visual-X: A Modular Framework for Pedagogically Aligned Lower-Primary Math Visuals Generation
summary: Visual representations can help lower-primary learners understand Math Word Problems, but generating classroom-usable visuals remains difficult. Existing symbolic systems are controllable but limited in coverage, while end-to-end text-to-image systems often fail to satisfy exact mathematical constraints. This paper presents a symbolic visual generation framework for lower-primary MWP generation with broader problem coverage and more scalable asset generation. The framework includes an LLM-based routing layer, three worksheet-oriented generation modules, and two fallback mechanisms for open-world SVG asset acquisition. A human evaluation comparing Math2Visual-X with Stable Diffusion XL, Nano Banana, and GPT Image showed that the proposed method achieved the strongest overall performance. The results indicate that the framework offers a scalable and pedagogically grounded approach for automatic MWP visual generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Math2Visual-X，一个面向小学低年级数学应用题（MWP）的符号化视觉生成框架，通过LLM路由层、三个练习纸导向的生成模块以及两种开放世界SVG素材回退机制，实现更广的问题覆盖与更可扩展的素材生成。人工评测显示其整体性能优于Stable Diffusion XL、Nano Banana与GPT Image。
AI.motivation: 视觉表征有助于小学低年级学生理解数学应用题，但生成可用于课堂的视觉图仍很困难：符号系统可控但覆盖范围有限，端到端文本到图像系统又难以满足精确的数学约束。因此需要一个兼具可控性、覆盖度与可扩展性的视觉生成方案。
AI.method: 提出符号化视觉生成框架Math2Visual-X，包含三部分：基于LLM的路由层、三个面向练习纸（worksheet）的生成模块，以及两种用于开放世界SVG素材获取的回退机制。
AI.result: 将Math2Visual-X与Stable Diffusion XL、Nano Banana、GPT Image进行人工评测对比，结果表明所提方法取得了最强的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为数学应用题视觉的自动生成提供了一条可扩展且具教学依据（pedagogically grounded）的路径。
